blockers.description: Fixture and scene slices contain large pre-existing legacy surfaces; no broad design-system exceptions may be used.
blockers.workaround: Continue in bounded directory-owned passes, with focused regression tests and scoped DS checks.

decisions.decision: Use strict generated semantic tokens and DS001-DS010 fail-closed checker as the UI authority.
decisions.rationale: Prevents future agents from guessing or silently adding one-off styling.

decisions.decision: Use a proof-only hash-locked local-module replacement plus Go overlay for packaged WebView2 CDP.
decisions.rationale: Wails v2/go-webview2 discards environment CDP arguments; the bridge proves the shipped desktop dialog without changing production dependencies or runtime defaults.

decisions.decision: Do not waive fixture/scene violations with broad exceptions.
decisions.rationale: The user requested enforced consistency; actual primitive/token migration is required.

next_action: Read the phase .continue-here.md, inspect the listed uncommitted files without reverting them, then finish 13-10 Task 2 and 13-11 using scoped DS checks before starting another Wave 7 plan.
context_notes: Three executors were deliberately interrupted for the requested pause. Their partial changes are preserved in the shared worktree and must be reviewed/continued rather than discarded. Protected unrelated user work has remained out of scope.
